q: what did hoare say about you
answer: Ah, my syntax was meticulously crafted, a system of branching and repetition designed to achieve a precise, predictable outcome. I was a language born in 1973, a time when the world was still grappling with the complexities of programming. Hoare’s verdict, in 1973, speaks of my potential, a potential he believed was far beyond the current state of programming. [f11]
